definitions.meaning: The form of energy that races out from a lamp or the Sun in straight lines and lets us see.
Warm energy that moves from hot things to cooler places: it rises up from a cooking pot into the air.
The form of energy made when something vibrates: it spreads out in all directions from where it is made, like sound from a radio.
The energy of something moving: a rolling car and a sliding ball carry movement energy.
Energy kept waiting until it is needed: it sits stored in a battery or in fuel, ready to change into other forms.
Energy carried by electricity as it travels along wires: a battery supplies it and a bulb changes it into light and heat.

mechanismSteps: Energy comes in many forms: light rays spread out in straight lines, heat rises up, sound spreads out from where it is made, movement slides along, and stored energy waits quietly in its box.
We use energy every day: a lamp sends out light, cooking heat rises from the pot, a radio sends out sound, and a car changes stored energy in its fuel into movement.
Energy changes form: electrical energy waits stored in the battery, travels along the wire to the bulb, and changes into light and heat at the bulb.
A common mistake: is energy used up? No - the energy travels from the stored circle to the heat circle along the chain, changing form and moving somewhere else instead of disappearing.
objectives: Name five forms of energy: light, heat, sound, movement and stored energy
Give an everyday use for each form of energy
Describe how electrical energy changes into light and heat at a bulb
Explain why energy is never used up
subject: science
title: Forms of energy

trap.explanation: A lamp or a toy runs out, so the energy feels consumed. Energy is never used up: it changes form and moves somewhere else. In the animation scene s4 the wrong line is crossed out and the energy dot is watched travelling from the stored circle to the heat circle - the same energy, transferred to a new form and a new place.
trap.misconception: Energy is used up, like fuel disappearing from a tank.

workedExample: In scene s3, follow the energy as a worked example: electrical energy waits stored in the battery, then travels along the wire to the bulb, where electrical energy becomes light and heat. Each step is a change of state: the light lets us see and the heat rises into the air, so no energy has been used up.
